_doc: ANALYTICAL FRAMING, NOT DATA. Written from credit-domain knowledge to tell the brief writer what usually drives repayment and stress in each sector. Never a source of figures.

mmf_textiles.what: Weavers and processors turn polyester/viscose yarn into grey and finished fabric, mostly selling on credit to Surat traders.
drivers: spread between POY/FDY yarn price and grey-fabric realisation
trader payment cycle in Surat textile markets
stress: production holidays called by weavers' associations
cheap Chinese fabric imports and GST input-credit inversion (yarn taxed higher than fabric)
checks: debtor days vs 90 and share of top-5 traders in receivables
yarn-to-fabric margin per metre vs last year
accumulated unutilised GST input credit vs net worth

cotton_textiles.what: Spinners buy raw cotton and sell cotton yarn to weavers, knitters and exporters.
drivers: cotton-yarn spread (yarn price minus cotton cost per kg)
power cost per kg of yarn
stress: cotton price spikes after poor crops or MSP shifts
yarn inventory piling up at mills
checks: cotton-yarn spread per kg vs 12-month average
inventory days of cotton and yarn vs 60
spindle utilisation and power cost per kg

apparel.what: Garment and knitwear units cut and stitch fabric into clothing, largely for US/EU brands and domestic retail.
stress: yarn cost rising faster than FOB prices
units closing or running short shifts
checks: confirmed export orders for the next 3 months vs capacity
yarn cost share of FOB price vs last year
export bill realisation days and ECGC cover

diamonds.what: Units cut and polish rough diamonds for export to the US, Hong Kong/China and the Gulf, alongside a growing lab-grown (LGD) segment.
drivers: polished demand in the US and China
rough diamond supply and price from miners
stress: polished inventory and receivable days lengthening
LGD prices falling faster than costs
checks: share of LGD in turnover and its price trend
concentration of buyers in Hong Kong/US and their payment record

chemicals_dyes.what: Makers of dyes, pigments and intermediates selling to textile, paint and pharma users at home and abroad.
checks: gross margin per tonne vs last year
pollution-board consent validity and CETP dues
export receivables by country and days

petrochem.what: Producers and converters of polymers and petrochemicals whose costs follow crude and naphtha.
checks: spread per tonne vs feedstock over last 4 quarters

pharma.what: Formulation and API makers selling in India and to regulated markets like the US.
stress: Form 483 observations, warning letters or import alerts
checks: latest USFDA/WHO-GMP inspection status of each plant
share of China-sourced inputs and price trend

ceramics.what: Tile and sanitaryware kilns, concentrated in Morbi, selling in India and exporting to the Gulf, US and Africa.
drivers: natural gas cost (a large share of production cost)
export demand and anti-dumping duties in the US/Gulf
capacity utilisation in a crowded cluster
stress: plants shutting kilns for days each week
payments stuck with dealers and packaging suppliers
checks: gas cost per sq m vs selling price
kiln utilisation and planned shutdown days
dealer receivable days vs 90 and export markets under anti-dumping

plastics.what: Moulding and extrusion units converting polymer granules into packaging, pipes and parts.
stress: polymer price spikes not passed on
checks: polymer cost share of sales vs last year

engineering.what: Makers of machinery, capital goods and fabricated parts for factories and infrastructure.
stress: steel cost rise on fixed-price contracts
retention money and receivables piling up

metals.what: Integrated and secondary steel makers and re-rollers.
drivers: steel price vs iron ore/coking coal/scrap
stress: scrap price spikes for induction units
checks: margin per tonne vs scrap/ore cost

electronics.what: Assemblers of phones, components and consumer electronics, often under PLI schemes.
stress: loss of a major brand customer

auto_components.what: Suppliers of parts to vehicle makers and the replacement market.
stress: engine-only product lines facing EV substitution
checks: share of sales to top OEM and its volume trend
share of ICE-only parts in revenue

paper.what: Mills making writing, printing and packaging paper from pulp, waste paper or agro residue.

food_processing.what: Processors of grains, spices, snacks and packaged foods.
stress: commodity price spikes not passed on

commercial_real_estate.what: Developers and owners of offices, malls and commercial projects.
checks: debt service cover from contracted rentals

beverages.what: Makers of soft drinks, alcohol and tobacco products.

leather.what: Tanneries and footwear/leather goods makers, largely export-led.

wood_plywood.what: Plywood, laminate and panel makers selling to furniture and housing.

refining.what: Refiners and coal-product makers whose margins depend on crude prices.
stress: inventory losses on crude price swings

fertiliser.what: Urea and complex fertiliser makers dependent on gas and imported inputs, with government subsidies.

cement.what: Cement plants selling to housing and infrastructure.

glass.what: Glass and glassware makers, often gas-fired (e.g., Firozabad).

nonferrous_brass.what: Brass, aluminium, copper and fabricated metal parts makers (e.g., Jamnagar, Moradabad).
stress: metal price volatility on fixed orders

electrical_eq.what: Makers of pumps, motors, cables and electrical equipment.

other_transport.what: Makers of cycles, two-wheelers and other transport equipment and parts.

furniture_misc.what: Furniture, toys, fireworks and miscellaneous manufacturing, often small units.

handicrafts.what: Carpet and handicraft exporters (e.g., Bhadohi, Moradabad).

sugar.what: Mills crushing cane into sugar and ethanol.
checks: sugar inventory vs monthly release quota

edible_oil.what: Crushers and refiners of edible oils.

tea.what: Tea estates and bought-leaf factories (Assam, Bengal, South).
drivers: auction prices vs cost of production
checks: auction realisation vs cost per kg

cashew.what: Processors of raw cashew nuts (Kerala, Karnataka), largely using imports.
stress: raw nut prices rising faster than kernel prices

jute_coir.what: Jute mills and coir product makers (Bengal, Kerala).

mining.what: Miners and quarry operators of coal, iron ore, limestone and minerals.

construction.what: EPC contractors building roads, buildings and infrastructure.

renewables.what: Solar and wind developers selling power under long-term contracts.

telecom.what: Telecom operators, tower and fibre companies.

other_infra.what: Ports, airports, railways and other infrastructure.

agriculture.what: Farmers and agri-allied activity (dairy, poultry, fisheries).

msme_micro_small.what: Micro and small enterprises across manufacturing, mostly working-capital borrowers.
drivers: payment cycles under the MSME delayed-payment rule
checks: GST returns vs bank credit summations

msme_medium.what: Medium enterprises, often suppliers to large corporates and exporters.

wholesale_trade.what: Wholesalers and distributors buying from makers and selling to retailers on credit.

retail_trade.what: Shops and retail chains selling to consumers.

software_it.what: IT services and software firms, mostly exporting to the US and Europe.

professional_services.what: Consultants, accountants, legal, advertising and similar service firms.

nbfc.what: Non-bank lenders that borrow from banks to lend onward.

tobacco.what: Cigarette, bidi and chewing-tobacco makers buying leaf at regulated auctions.
drivers: GST compensation cess and excise changes
checks: share of exports in sales vs last year

coffee.what: Coffee curers, traders and exporters buying beans from Karnataka/Kerala estates.
stress: price falls after stocks bought high
checks: stock position vs pledged warehouse receipts

rice_milling.what: Rice mills buying paddy, milling for the government (custom milling) and for export.
drivers: basmati demand from the Gulf and Iran
stress: custom-milled rice dues from state agencies
checks: stock vs drawing power (monthly stock audit)
share of exports to a single country vs 40%

spices.what: Spice traders, cleaners and grinders buying farm produce (jeera, chilli, turmeric, pepper).
stress: sharp price falls on stocked produce
checks: stock age and value vs current mandi price
export rejection history in the last 12 months

marine_meat_dairy.what: Seafood, meat, dairy and poultry processors, many export-oriented.
stress: milk procurement price outrunning sale price
checks: raw-material cost share vs last year

fruits_veg.what: Pulp, dehydrated onion, pickles, frozen-vegetable and juice makers.

carpets.what: Hand-knotted and tufted carpet exporters, largely selling to US and European importers.
checks: confirmed orders for the next 3 months vs capacity
advances to weavers vs net worth

shipping.what: Ship owners and operators earning freight and charter hire.
checks: DSCR at current charter rates vs 1.2
charter contract tenor vs loan tenor

ports.what: Port terminals, stevedores and port-service providers.

railways_infra.what: Private rail sidings, freight terminals and rail-infra contractors.

housing_finance.what: Bank loans to housing finance companies that on-lend for home purchase.
stress: rising early delinquencies in affordable housing
checks: share of developer loans in book vs 15%

other_services.what: Hospitals, schools, media and other services not separately classified.
stress: staff cost rising faster than fees
checks: receivables from insurers or government vs 90 days
